WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.id,c.receipt_key AS artifact_key,s.title,s.title_source,
    (SELECT json_extract(feedback.payload,'$.summary') FROM session_events feedback WHERE feedback.session_id=s.id AND feedback.kind='observed' AND feedback.receipt_key='legacy_review_feedback') AS feedback_summary,s.completed_at,s.interactive,s.task_id,s.wave_id,
    (SELECT gs.graph_lf_process_id FROM session_events captured JOIN graph_process_steps gs ON gs.lf_process_id=captured.lf_process_id WHERE captured.seq=s.current_capture) AS graph_lf_process_id,s.cwd,s.skill,s.provider,s.model,(SELECT gs.node FROM session_events captured JOIN graph_process_steps gs ON gs.lf_process_id=captured.lf_process_id WHERE captured.seq=s.current_capture) AS node,(SELECT gs.iterations FROM session_events captured JOIN graph_process_steps gs ON gs.lf_process_id=captured.lf_process_id WHERE captured.seq=s.current_capture) AS iterations,s.current_capture
    FROM agent_sessions s LEFT JOIN session_events c ON c.seq=s.current_capture WHERE 1 AND s.interactive=?1 AND s.completed_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.repo,(SELECT repo FROM waves WHERE id=s.wave_id))=?2 ORDER BY s.title, s.id LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4)
        SELECT s.id,s.artifact_key,s.title,s.title_source,s.feedback_summary,s.completed_at,s.interactive,s.task_id,s.wave_id,s.graph_lf_process_id,s.cwd,s.skill,s.provider,s.model,s.node,s.iterations,s.current_capture,graph_process.id,graph.graph,graph_process.outcome,graph_process.completed_at,step.started_at,
        (gs.seq=(SELECT MAX(later.seq) FROM graph_process_steps later WHERE later.graph_lf_process_id=gs.graph_lf_process_id)),
        w.slug,
        ((SELECT CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN CASE WHEN json_extract(payload,'$.source')='manifest.json' AND json_extract(payload,'$.evidence.schema_version')=1 AND json_extract(payload,'$.evidence.artifact_key')=json_extract(payload,'$.input_id') AND receipt_key=json_extract(payload,'$.input_id')||':manifest.json' THEN json_extract(payload,'$.evidence.flow.kind') END END FROM session_events INDEXED BY session_input_membership
         WHERE session_id=s.id AND captured_event=s.current_capture
         AND kind='observed' AND substr(receipt_key,-14)=':manifest.json')='independent'),
        (SELECT json_group_array(id) FROM (SELECT tw.id FROM tasks tw WHERE a.primary_scope IS NULL
         AND (a.task_id=tw.id OR (tw.checkout_machine_id=(SELECT id FROM machines WHERE is_local=1) AND tw.worktree!='' AND (a.cwd=rtrim(tw.worktree,'/') OR instr(a.cwd,rtrim(tw.worktree,'/')||'/')=1))) ORDER BY tw.id)),
        a.primary_scope,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_activity act
            JOIN processes p ON p.id=a.agent_process_id
            WHERE act.session_id=a.id
            AND a.completed_at IS NULL AND act.agent_process_id IS a.agent_process_id
            AND p.completed_at IS NULL
            AND CASE WHEN act.program_status IS NOT NULL THEN
                EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(act.program_status,'$.records') r
                    WHERE json_extract(r.value,'$.state')='blocked'
                    OR (a.interactive=1 AND json_extract(r.value,'$.state')='idle'))
            ELSE act.attachment_token=p.attachment_token
                AND (act.pending_input>0 OR (act.open_tools=0 AND ((a.interactive=1 AND act.yielded=1)
                    OR 1794413087-act.observed_at>=120))) END),
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.abandoned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'abandoned' WHEN t.planning_completed=1 THEN 'done' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM processes lp WHERE lp.completed_at IS NULL AND (lp.id=t.ship_lf_process_id OR lp.id=(SELECT tg.lf_process_id FROM task_graphs tg WHERE tg.task_id=t.id))) THEN CASE WHEN t.shipped_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'shipping' ELSE 'moving' END WHEN t.shipped_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_graphs tg WHERE tg.task_id=t.id AND tg.lf_process_id IS NULL AND tg.step NOT IN ('start','end')) THEN 'active' WHEN t.worktree IS NULL THEN 'unstarted' ELSE 'idle' END) IN ('done','abandoned'),0),
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks p WHERE p.primary_session_id=s.id),
        (SELECT act.program_status FROM session_activity act WHERE act.session_id=s.id AND act.agent_process_id IS a.agent_process_id),a.agent_process_id,p.completed_at,p.pid,p.os_started_at,(SELECT terminal_id FROM processes WHERE id=p.attached_lf_process_id AND completed_at IS NULL),
        (SELECT act.preview FROM session_activity act WHERE act.session_id=s.id AND act.agent_process_id IS a.agent_process_id
         AND json_extract(act.preview,'$.provider_thread')=a.provider_thread
         AND act.attachment_token=p.attachment_token AND p.attached_lf_process_id IS NOT NULL AND a.completed_at IS NULL),
        p.started_at,
        COALESCE((SELECT o.viewed=0 FROM processes o WHERE o.id=a.transport_lf_process_id AND o.completed_at IS NULL),0),
        (SELECT pin.account_id FROM provider_session_accounts pin WHERE pin.provider=s.provider AND pin.provider_session_id=a.provider_thread),
        EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM session_events history
            WHERE history.session_id=s.id AND history.captured_event=s.current_capture
            AND history.kind='observed'
            AND CASE WHEN json_valid(history.payload) THEN
                (instr(history.receipt_key,':provider-session:')>0
                 OR (instr(history.receipt_key,':events.jsonl:')>0
                     AND json_extract(history.payload,'$.evidence.type')='provider_session_observed'))
            AND json_extract(history.payload,'$.evidence.schema_version')=1
            AND length(json_extract(history.payload,'$.evidence.provider_session_id'))>0 END)
        FROM page s JOIN agent_sessions a ON a.id=s.id
        LEFT JOIN processes p ON p.id=a.agent_process_id
        LEFT JOIN session_events captured ON captured.seq=s.current_capture
        LEFT JOIN graph_process_steps gs ON gs.lf_process_id=captured.lf_process_id
        LEFT JOIN graph_processes graph ON graph.lf_process_id=gs.graph_lf_process_id
        LEFT JOIN processes step ON step.id=gs.lf_process_id
        LEFT JOIN processes graph_process ON graph_process.id=gs.graph_lf_process_id
        LEFT JOIN wave_addresses w ON w.id=s.wave_id
        LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.id=s.task_id
        ORDER BY s.title,s.id
